body: Independent review of unpublished candidate eaad98d663d11aa3dbcc3dbb1d04e87e8d3f9239 found script/proof-tour.sh:166,171 writes auxiliary resume receipts without collision checks. Isolated reproduction /private/tmp/proof-tour-review-collision.xO2pi2 precreated resume-1-ack.txt as a symlink, and resume overwrote its target. Expected: preflight every owned destination, reject collisions and preserve existing bytes. Candidate-only confirmed defect; installed Core is not implicated. Owning feature V1-0504, root integration V1-0516.
title: Proof tour must reject existing ACK and identity receipt destinations
